source_issue.title: Polish documentation renames, and overall shape

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue involves polishing the documentation for the Plone Aurora project after recent renames. Following earlier changes, some sections, particularly "Contributing," still reflect previous terminology from Volto.

## What needs to be done
- Review and update the "Contributing" section of the documentation to better align with the current state of Plone Aurora.
- Ensure that all links, especially to Storybook, are accurate and updated.

## Helpful background
The documentation has undergone some significant updates, but adjustments are still needed. The recent discussion highlighted that some references, like "Seven," were outdated. It’s essential to ensure that all terms and links are current for clarity and accuracy.

## Good first steps
1. Check the current documentation at [Plone Aurora documentation](https://plone-aurora.readthedocs.io/).
2. Focus on the "Contributing" section to identify outdated references.
3. Validate all links, especially those redirecting to Storybook.
4. Consider reviewing the issue discussions for any additional insights or ambiguity, as current discussions may not clarify all aspects.
5. Feel free to ask questions on this issue or in discussions if anything is unclear!
```
